spec.description: The observation stations usable for a grid cell, nearest first. Each carries its `distance` and `bearing` from the cell.

request.title: ListStationsForGridpointRequest
request.description: Which grid cell, and how many stations.

office.description: Three-letter forecast office code addressing the grid, such as `SEW`. `points.get_point` returns it as `gridId`.

limit.description: Most stations to return, nearest kept. Range [1, 500]; outside it the service answers 400. Without it, every station (73 for SEW 125,68 on 2026-09-30).

notes: No `pagination` block, for the reason `stations.list_stations` gives: the next page is a whole URL, and here not even this endpoint's (`/stations?id[0]=...&cursor=...`).
